BackstoryDef.title: citadel squire
BackstoryDef.description: Born into the direct bloodline of the Brotherhood's founder, [PAWN_nameDef] was sent east as a boy to be raised inside a fortified bunker. Trained in combat drills and sacred codices from an early age, [PAWN_pronoun] bore the heavy expectations of [PAWN_possessive] name with grim seriousness.

BackstoryDef.title: supreme elder
BackstoryDef.description: Rising to become the youngest Elder in Brotherhood history after slaying a super mutant warlord in single combat, [PAWN_nameDef] reunited fractured chapters under one iron banner. Charismatic, uncompromising, and fiercely protective of humanity's future, [PAWN_pronoun] leads crusades against unchecked technology.

BackstoryDef.title: bunker initiate
BackstoryDef.description: Raised in the strict monastic discipline of a western Brotherhood bunker, [PAWN_nameDef] studied pre-war archives and military history while [PAWN_possessive] peers focused solely on weapons. Even in [PAWN_possessive] youth, [PAWN_pronoun] questioned whether hoarding relics mattered more than saving lives.

BackstoryDef.title: veteran guardian elder
BackstoryDef.description: After leading an expedition across the ruins of the Capital Wasteland, [PAWN_nameDef] defied rigid doctrine to shield local settlers from super mutants and bring clean water to the region. Now an aging senior advisor serving beneath Arthur Maxson, [PAWN_pronoun] tempers zealous crusades with hard-earned wisdom.

BackstoryDef.title: commander's daughter
BackstoryDef.description: Determined never to be seen as a sheltered officer's child, [PAWN_nameDef] pushed [PAWN_objective]self harder than any recruit on the firing range. [PAWN_pronoun] earned every stripe through bruised knuckles, sharp marksmanship, and fearless grit.

BackstoryDef.title: vanguard sentinel
BackstoryDef.description: Commander of an elite reconnaissance and strike unit, [PAWN_nameDef] spent years fighting on the bloodiest frontlines of the wasteland. Bold, sarcastic, and fiercely loyal to [PAWN_possessive] squad, [PAWN_pronoun] never asks a soldier to charge anywhere [PAWN_pronoun] wouldn't go first.

BackstoryDef.title: wasteland scrap orphan
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up alone in a rusted settlement built from a stranded aircraft carrier, [PAWN_nameDef] survived by scavenging and repairing salvageable junk. When Brotherhood recruiters arrived seeking able-bodied youths, [PAWN_pronoun] enlisted without looking back.

BackstoryDef.title: devoted field paladin
BackstoryDef.description: Forged into an exemplary soldier by years of brutal campaigns, [PAWN_nameDef] lives and breathes the Brotherhood's chain of command. Stoic, honorable, and relentless in battle, [PAWN_pronoun] leads deep-recon teams into hostile territory with unwavering resolve.

BackstoryDef.title: academy strategist
BackstoryDef.description: Raised within the disciplined halls of a Brotherhood stronghold, [PAWN_nameDef] excelled at navigation, logistics, and tactical wargames. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early that victory depends as much on supply lines and timing as on firepower.

BackstoryDef.title: airship commander
BackstoryDef.description: As commanding officer of the Brotherhood's flagship airship, [PAWN_nameDef] oversees aerial deployments, intelligence operations, and fleet discipline with clinical precision. Calm under pressure and utterly unsentimental, [PAWN_pronoun] executes orders down to the smallest detail.

BackstoryDef.title: scribe apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Surrounded by diagnostic terminals and disassembled servos from childhood, [PAWN_nameDef] possessed an intuitive gift for pre-war engineering. [PAWN_pronoun] preferred grease-stained wrenches and schematic blueprints over formal ceremonies.

BackstoryDef.title: armored chief engineer
BackstoryDef.description: After losing both legs when a cliffside collapsed beneath [PAWN_possessive] squad, [PAWN_nameDef] refused medical retirement and engineered a modified power armor frame to keep working. Tireless, sharp-tongued, and brilliant, [PAWN_pronoun] keeps the entire fleet's armor and reactors running.
